{{Quote|The boy's a Jedi. Kill him.|Boba Fett, to the Ma'alkerrite ape-men and other patrons assembled at Al the Alchemist's cantina|<ref name="The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book" />}}
The '''Ma'alkerrite ape-men''' were an [[Ape/Legends|ape]]-like [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book" /> hailing from the [[Ma'alkerr system/Legends|Ma'alkerr system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=Ma'alkerrite ape-men|homeworld=the [[Ma'alkerr system/Legends|Ma'alkerr system]]|legends=1}}</ref> They had contact with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a group of Ma'alkerrite ape-men visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Al The Alchemist's]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], which was frequented by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Smuggler/Legends|gun-runners]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] from across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the infamous [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] among them. That [[Standard day/Legends|day]], [[Havet Storm]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] boy whose [[Morvet Storm|grandfather]] had been a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], entered the cantina. The patrons soon discovered that Storm was carrying a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], so the Ma'alkerrite ape-men and other bar-goers clustered around the boy, staring at him aggressively. Fett, who was carrying a grudge against the boy from another encounter, ordered the assorted patrons of the cantina to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Storm,<ref name="The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book" /> but the boy escaped.<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They are standing around you in a close ring &mdash; humans, lizard-like Druulgothans, Ma'alkerrite ape-men, winged Banasthaurs &mdash; gun-runners, mercenaries, and bounty hunters from all across the galaxy. And they are all staring at you.|A mention of Ma'alkerrite ape-men in the front matter of ''The Lost Jedi''|<ref name="The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book" />}}
[[Paul Cockburn]] created the Ma'alkerrite ape-men for his pick-a-path adventure ''[[Jedi Dawn]]'', published by [[Boxtree]] in [[1993]]. The ape-men are not mentioned in the adventure itself, only in the front matter immediately following the book's cover.<ref name="The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book" /> The scene described there matches a scene contained in the actual adventure, including the same quotation from Boba Fett.
